review.gallery: Ten original native Soto Grande renders extracted from the developer brochure distributed by Mitchell’s. Decorative PDF masks excluded.
review.location: Page 5 of the Ellington project brief marks Soto Grande and prints nine estimates. Madena and Discovery Space locate the same vicinity. The developer describes a future bridge, and Wynn Resorts’ November 2026 report projects a September 2027 opening.
review.floorPlans: 26 full original drawings. Eleven residential designs with their printed areas, ten typical plates and five shared amenity drawings. The project brief duplicates the same layout figures and is linked for location evidence.

unavailable: Exact tower entrances, signed unit-specific area schedules and additional individual variants beyond the published typical plans were not established.
